## [How to Brief Food Creators for a Retail Launch](https://www.jupiter.co/blog/how-to-brief-food-creators-retail-launch)


A retail launch brief has one job: get your product into a recipe that shoppers near your stores want to make this week. Here is what to include, what to leave to the creator, and how to tell if it worked.
